title: Finite-cube Fourier coefficient agreement
statement: For a natural number $n$, a function $f$ from the sign cube on $n$ coordinates to $ br$, and a set of coordinates $S$, the Fourier coefficient of $f$ defined using indexed sign assignments equals the coefficient defined using the finite sign cube: both are the uniform average of $f(x)$ times the product of the signs in $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube with $n$ coordinates
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates among those $n$
